name: 30-day prior price
description: Shows the lowest price of the 30 days before a reduction as the struck-through price, as EU price-indication rules ask (Directive 98/6/EC art. 6a; in Bulgaria ЗЗП чл. 65). Keeps a history of every variant's price.

settings.label: Days looked back
settings.help: The prior price is the lowest price of this many days before the reduction. 30 in the EU.

settings.label: Count back-to-back reductions as one
settings.help: On: when a sale price is lowered again during a sale, the prior price stays the one from before the first reduction.

settings.label: Reductions older than the price history

options.hide: Show the price without a reduction

settings.help: The history starts when the plugin is installed. For a sale that began before that, the shop cannot prove the lowest earlier price.

author: PN Scripts
